releaseNotes: 10.12.2: Adds the static extension Error.Unauthorized(ref readonly PasswordValidator.Results, instance, description, type) that 10.12.1's notes promised but did not ship (Error.Unauthorized(in results) failed to compile with CS1615). 10.12.1: Jakar.ErrorOr no longer depends on Jakar.Extensions; Jakar.Extensions depends on it instead. Pair, Pair<TValue>, StringTags, Status, Statuses, IErrorDetails, IErrorTitles, ErrorTitles and NullAsEmptyArrayConverter<T, TConverter> moved to Jakar.ErrorOr and are type-forwarded (no source or binary change); Status.GetErrorTitle()/GetErrorType() stay here. New: PasswordValidator.Results.ToStringTags() and the static extension Error.Unauthorized(ref readonly PasswordValidator.Results, ...) (both were in Jakar.ErrorOr). Requires Jakar.ErrorOr 10.2.0 or later (10.1.0 depends on Jakar.Extensions 10.12.0). 10.12.0: BREAKING: five areas moved to their own packages, which depend on Jakar.Extensions and keep the Jakar.Extensions namespace (add the package and recompile): Jakar.Files (LocalFile, LocalDirectory, LocalFileWatcher, TempFile, FilePaths, PathExtensions, FileData/FileMetaData, EmbeddedResources, IniConfig, PreferenceFile, AppPreference/IAppPreferences, and with them IAppInfo, AppSettings/IAppSettings/IScreenshot and LanguageApi; the LocalFile/EmbeddedResources overloads of IDataProtector, DataProtector and PasswordRequirements are extension members there, so IDataProtector implementations drop them and IDataProtector.Decryptor/DecryptorAsync became DataProtectorFiles.Decryptor/DecryptorAsync), Jakar.ErrorOr (Error, Errors, Alert, ErrorOrResult, ErrorExtensions, All/Some/Success/Unknown), Jakar.Http (WebRequester, WebHandler, WebResponse, ErrorResponse, HeaderCollection, UriExtensions, networking exceptions; Error.TryCreate(WebResponse) is a static extension there), Jakar.Users (user/group/role/address models, LoginRequest*, Claims, ClaimType, Permissions, UserRights, JwtParser, EmailBuilder) and Jakar.Logging (AppLoggerOptions, Enricher, FileLoggerProvider, ScopeProvider, NullScope, OpenTelemetryActivityEnricher, IOpenTelemetryActivityEnricher, ScreenShot). Status, Statuses, the MIME types, StringTags, IErrorTitles/ErrorTitles, None, Email, IUserName and SelfLogger stay here. Serilog, Microsoft.IdentityModel.*, Microsoft.Extensions.Http and ZLinq.FileSystem are no longer dependencies. AppInformation, DeviceInformation, GcInfo, GcMemoryInformation, GcGenerationInformation and ThreadInformation lost their Serilog members (Jakar.Logging adds GetProperty/ToProperty back as extension members); DeviceInformation is no longer an ILogEventEnricher (device.ToEnricher() in Jakar.Logging). The global using static WebRequester/Claims no longer flows from here. 10.10.0: ValueStringBuilder and Sizes moved to the new dependency Jakar.Spans (same namespace, type-forwarded, so no source or binary change); Jakar.Spans adds ValueUtf8Builder and ValueSpanReader<T>. BREAKING: System.Text.Json replaces Newtonsoft.Json; the library is trim and Native AOT compatible (source-generated metadata only). New dependency Jakar.Json (IJsonModel<TSelf>, the [JsonModel] source generator and analyzers, pooled element-wise JSON arrays, SerializeAsStringJsonConverter<T>, plus the Jakar.Json serializer, which [JsonModel] uses behind IJsonModel when it supports the type: most models' ToJson/FromJson now run on it, laid out as Jakar.Json writes ("name" : value) with the context's options mirrored; JsonTypeInfo stays System.Text.Json's); types stay in the Jakar.Extensions namespace. IJsonModel<TSelf> requires static JsonTypeInfo (add [JsonModel]). JToken/JObject/JValue removed: AdditionalData is Dictionary<string, JsonElement>?, ErrorResponse/WebHandler.AsJson/FeedBackTrackerException use JsonNode, ExceptionDetails.Data is JsonObject, LoginRequestValue uses JsonElement. Json.Settings/LoadSettings replaced by Json.Options/AddResolver/GetTypeInfo; generic ToJson<T>(this T) only for IJsonModel types (else Json.Serialize). Typed JsonNode/JsonElement get/add/update/remove helpers. JSON written by 10.x still reads (case-insensitive names, numbers in strings, comments, trailing commas); output keeps PascalCase. PreferenceFile stores {TSelf}.json and imports an existing .ini. Observable collections serialize their unfiltered contents and read in bulk. LocalFile/LocalDirectory serialize as {"FullPath"}. ExceptionDetails(Exception, bool) became Create / CreateWithMethodInfo. WebRequester: AsJson(JsonTypeInfo), AsJsonArray/AsJsonList, BaseClass bodies serialized as their runtime type. Fixes: Json.ToJson(ReadOnlySpan) serialized the whole pooled rental; LocalFile.WriteAsync(string) wrote empty files; LoginRequest copy constructors passed the login as the password; Email.TryParse returned the inverse; GcInfo did not deserialize MemoryInfo. Removed the unused ValueOf package. 10.11.0: BREAKING: built on Jakar.Json 10.3.0, which no longer has System.Text.Json: the library serializes with Jakar.Json only. IJsonModel<TSelf>, the System.Text.Json contexts (JakarExtensionsContext, UserGuidJsonContext, UserLongJsonContext), Json.Options/AddResolver/GetTypeInfo and every JsonTypeInfo overload are removed: models are [JsonModel] types (IJsonSerializable<TSelf>), and generic helpers are constrained to IJsonSerializable<T> or take an IJsonConverter<T> (Json.Serialize<T, TConverter> / Json.Deserialize<T, TConverter>). JsonNode/JsonElement/JsonObject became Jakar.Json's JNode/JObjectNode: AdditionalData (JObjectNode?, ordinal keys, [JsonOverflow]), ErrorResponse, FeedBackTrackerException, ExceptionDetails.Data, LoginRequestValue.Data, IniConfig.ToJsonObject/FromJsonObject and the typed get/add/update helpers; the JsonElement helpers are gone. Output uses Jakar.Json's layout, compact by default; preference files are written indented. PreferenceFile<TSelf> subclasses implement CopyFrom(TSelf). AppVersion is no longer a [JsonModel] (it is written as a JSON string, as before; ToJson/FromJson remain). Observable collections: the System.Text.Json converters are removed; IJsonCollection<TSelf, T> covers [JsonModel] members, root ToJson/FromJson need [JsonModel] elements (or ObservableJson.ToJson/FromJson with a converter). LocalFile/LocalDirectory no longer read a plain path string. WebRequester.CreateJsonContent/CreateJsonArrayContent take JsonWriterOptions, and CreateJsonContentOfRuntimeType resolves the type with JsonCodecRegistry. Jakar.Json's attributes are kept in this assembly's metadata (JAKAR_JSON_KEEP_ATTRIBUTES), so [JsonModel] types in other assemblies see [JsonOverflow] on BaseClass.AdditionalData. New: NullAsEmptyArrayConverter<T, TConverter>; StringTags reads missing or null Tags/Entries as empty. BREAKING: IIObservableCollection<TValue> renamed to IObservableCollection<TValue>. BREAKING: Command<TValue> now follows CommunityToolkit.Mvvm AsyncRelayCommand<T> semantics and implements the new IAsyncCommand<TValue>: ExecutionTask, IsRunning, CanBeCanceled, IsCancellationRequested (with PropertyChanged), ExecuteAsync returning Task, Cancel(), NotifyCanExecuteChanged() (CanExecute no longer raises CanExecuteChanged itself), CommandOptions (AllowConcurrentExecutions, FlowExceptionsToTaskScheduler), CreateCancelCommand(); CanExecute is false while running by default; starting a cancellable handler cancels the previous token; Execute rethrows handler failures on the calling context unless FlowExceptionsToTaskScheduler; object parameters of the wrong type throw ArgumentException. Command<TValue>.Executable accepts CancellationToken-taking handlers, adds Execute(object?, TValue?, CancellationToken), is 16 bytes instead of 72, and no longer drops the Task from Func<TValue?, Task> handlers (it is now awaited). Fixed SelfLogger.WriteLine throwing FormatException for named template holes such as {Error}. Internal folder restructure. Removed the unused Portable.BouncyCastle dependency and System.* package references that are part of the net10.0 shared framework. 10.11.1: Fixed ArrayBuffer<T>.Create / ToArrayBuffer() on sources that cannot report their count (e.g. after Order()): the result held 64 slots padded with default values instead of exactly the source's items. 10.10.0: TelemetrySource uses W3C activity IDs: the process-wide hierarchical default is gone and the StartActivity idFormat default is now Unknown (default parameter values are compiled into call sites, so recompile callers). StartActivity respects the sampler: it returns null instead of throwing when sampled out, no longer forces IsAllDataRequested, the Recorded trace flag (traceFlags is now ActivityTraceFlags?) or Ok status, and keeps the parent tracestate. Constructing a TelemetrySource no longer clears Activity.Current. AppVersion has a TypeConverter, so it binds from configuration strings. TelemetrySpan can target a specific TelemetrySource via TelemetrySpan.Create(TelemetrySource, string).
